name: bob-jones-ibuki
reference_text: The Our Sanchin is designed basically for one-pointedness, bringing timing, coordination, aggression and channeling everything into one point, which of course in time builds up the self-confidence of the martial artist. The important thing is with the heavy breathing, which is very similar to yoga breathing, but it's called ibuki. The breathing from Japan is done very aggressively from the diaphan.
